enableStatblockImporter.name: Statblock Importer
enableStatblockImporter.hint: Adds an Import Statblock button to the Actors sidebar (GM only). Paste a vault bestiary markdown file to preview its stats against the GM Core creature-building benchmarks and create the NPC.

statblockImporter.pasteHint: Paste a vault bestiary markdown file. Prose outside the statblock blocks becomes the NPC's public notes.
statblockImporter.pickCreatureHint: This file declares several creatures. Pick one to import.
statblockImporter.multipleStatblocks: This file declares several creatures ({ids}); pick one to import.
statblockImporter.unknownCreatureId: No creature "{id}" in this file (it declares: {ids}).
statblockImporter.notAStatblock: No `creatures: […]` frontmatter array with statblock blocks found.
